create_PromptLogprobsWorker: create a PromptLogprobsWorker instance to manage prompt logprobs for GPU inference requests
add_request_prompt_logprobs: add a request to the PromptLogprobsWorker with sampling params enabling prompt logprobs computation
compute_prompt_logprobs: compute prompt logprobs for a batch of GPU inference requests using hidden states and token IDs
